edits.old: Fiber and starch loci co-localized in three genomic regions. On chromosome 7H, the fiber locus (7H:573,606,306–573,606,491) was contained within the starch locus (7H:573,606,282–573,607,845), and the two lead SNPs were only 154 bp apart. On chromosome 1H, four loci fell within 1.02 Mb (1H:329,707,484–330,726,559): a starch locus (1H:330,363,275–330,562,842) nested between two fiber loci 121 kb and 58 kb away on either side, with a third fiber locus 532 kb upstream of the nearer one (1H:329,707,484). On chromosome 3H, the widest fiber locus (3H:543,987,340–545,715,157) was followed 595 kb downstream by a starch locus (3H:546,310,483–546,479,480). In contrast, none of the β-glucan loci overlapped or neighbored a locus of another trait, and the nearest one was located 6.0 Mb away (β-glucan, 3H:537,170,537–537,450,835; fiber, 3H:543,452,211–543,931,257), although β-glucan was phenotypically correlated with both starch and fiber (Fig. 2b).
